title: Motivation for AI and machine learning
exampleQuestions: Why is Hamza interested in AI?
What does he think of evaluating AI systems?
answer: Hamza wants to work on AI systems that real users depend on. In his view, building a model is only half of the job: the other half is evaluating it honestly and making it useful. That thread runs through his work: an evaluation pipeline for generative AI workflows at Delta Quest, a blind protocol to choose a language model for his interview-preparation app, and compliance designed from the start. He describes himself as at the beginning of his professional career in machine learning, looking for a team to learn from experienced engineers while contributing from the first weeks.
